module: Lifecycle callbacks for the garage photo mode UI routes. For the "garage.photomode" routes (and "garage.photomode.*"), opens a photomode session with the "garage" profile on entry, attaches the route data provided by ui_pause_providers_routeData_photomode, and closes the session on exit. Other routes are ignored.
notes: Depends on ui_pause_providers_routeData_photomode and ui_pause_photomode (declared in M.dependencies).
All three hooks call dump(...) to log the route name (debug traces left in the code).
onPhotomodeLeave has no route name filter: it calls onPhotomodeRouteLeave and endPhotomodeSession for any exit notified to it.

onPhotomodeEnter.desc: Hook called when the UI enters a photomode route. If the route is garage.photomode[.*]: starts the photomode session ("garage" profile), adds data.photomode and notifies onPhotomodeRouteEnter.

toRoute.desc: Target route; only the name field is read.

onPhotomodeMount.desc: Hook called when the route is mounted: adds data.photomode if the route is garage.photomode[.*].

toRoute.desc: Target route; only name is read.

onPhotomodeLeave.desc: Hook called when leaving the route: notifies onPhotomodeRouteLeave then ends the photomode session (endPhotomodeSession).

toRoute.desc: Destination route; name passed to onPhotomodeRouteLeave.

fromRoute.desc: Route being left (used for the log).
